## Remarks

Decoding hands the decoded [FileData](./contracts.filedata.md) to `DecodeContext.bindFile`<!-- -->, which keeps the grant private to the bound value. Encoding is the runtime's, from `FileData`<!-- -->; a value without a grant, such as a bound `FileValue`<!-- -->, is rejected, because operation inputs take file sources.
